brief:
The Guardian newspaper has called on the British government to impose a comprehensive trade embargo with Israeli settlements, Maan Wire reported. The publication's position reflects escalating scrutiny of settlement expansion across occupied Palestinian territories and argues that a sweeping trade ban would constitute a meaningful policy response to Israeli settlement activities.

The Guardian's call amplifies international pressure on Israel's settlement policies, which have drawn criticism from governments, human rights organizations, and advocacy groups worldwide. Various countries and international bodies have already implemented targeted measures against settlement-linked products and businesses, though comprehensive trade bans remain uncommon among Western nations. The call reflects broader debate over economic measures as leverage in the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
title: Guardian calls Britain to ban all trade with Israeli settlements
